subject: Request: move signup bonus from sandbox workspace to production
messages:
From: Lina Gomez <lina@brightfleet.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@brightfleet.com
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Signup bonus landed in test workspace — can this be moved to prod?

Hi Mina,

We completed our PLG signup last week and received the $5k signup bonus — thanks for making that available. It looks like the credit landed in our BrightFleet-sandbox workspace (workspace id: ws_8f3a) while our team is already billing against BrightFleet-prod (workspace id: ws_1b2c).

Could you advise whether the signup bonus can be moved from the sandbox workspace to the production workspace? We're trying to avoid spinning up another paid project if the credit can be reassigned. If you need any admin confirmation from our side I can loop in our Finance/Procurement team (procure@brightfleet.com).

Attached: admin_console_screenshot.png and billing_export_20260625.csv for reference.

Thanks,
Lina
Lina Gomez
Head of Growth, BrightFleet Inc.
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Gomez <lina@brightfleet.com>
Cc: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Signup bonus landed in test workspace — can this be moved to prod?

Hi Lina — thanks for the details and the screenshots.

Short answer: in many cases we can reassign PLG signup credits between workspaces under the same Redwood account, but we need a quick verification from an account admin and our Billing team needs the Target workspace ID and confirmation that BrightFleet-prod is part of the same Redwood account.

Can you confirm the account owner email and paste the production workspace id again? Once we have that I will open a promo-transfer request and loop in our Billing engineer (cc'd). If Finance would prefer to sign an approval email from procure@brightfleet.com that works too.

I will also check whether we can extend your trial window while we complete the transfer — happy to approve a short extension if needed.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
From: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Lina Gomez <lina@brightfleet.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Signup bonus landed in test workspace — can this be moved to prod?

Thanks Mina — adding the operational steps so Lina has transparency.

Hi Lina,

We can do a same-account credit transfer if: (1) both workspaces belong to the same Redwood org, and (2) the request is initiated by an org admin or authorized procurement email. If those conditions are met we typically process the transfer within 48 business hours.

To move forward please reply with either:
- confirmation from an org admin email (procure@brightfleet.com is fine), or
- the org id (org_bf_77) and both workspace ids (sandbox ws_8f3a and prod ws_1b2c).

Once we have that I will create promo-transfer ticket TF-8893 and run the transfer. I can also apply a 14-day trial extension to the prod workspace while we finish.

Attachments: sample_transfer_request_template.txt (please fill in and return)

Cheers,
Dev Patel
Billing Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Lina Gomez <lina@brightfleet.com>
To: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@brightfleet.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Signup bonus landed in test workspace — can this be moved to prod?

Hi all — thanks for the quick replies.

Confirming: procure@brightfleet.com is an authorized procurement email, and both workspaces are under org id org_bf_77. The production workspace id is ws_1b2c. I attached the admin console screenshot so you can see both workspaces listed under our org.

We would also appreciate the 14-day extension while the credits are being reassigned — we have traffic starting this week and want to make sure there is no interruption.

Please proceed and let me know if you need anything else.

— Lina
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Gomez <lina@brightfleet.com>
Cc: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Promo transfer created: TF-8893 — moving signup bonus to BrightFleet-prod

Lina — thanks for confirming.

I've opened internal ticket TF-8893 and requested the Billing team to perform the transfer from ws_8f3a (sandbox) to ws_1b2c (prod) within the same org (org_bf_77). We have also applied a 14-day trial extension to ws_1b2c so your team will not see interruptions while we finalize the transfer.

Next steps (what to expect):
- Dev will execute the transfer and attach the confirmation PDF to this thread.
- You will receive an email once the credits are visible in the prod workspace (please check the billing page and send a screenshot if anything looks off).
- If the org uses consolidated billing, the accounting export may show a negative promo line in the sandbox workspace and a matching credit line in prod.

Attaching: promo_transfer_confirmation.pdf (will be attached when completed).

Thanks for your patience — looping in Soojin from Account Ops in case we need a final verification.

Best,
Mina
From: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Gomez <lina@brightfleet.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: TF-8893 completed — signup bonus moved to ws_1b2c (BrightFleet-prod)

Hi Lina & team,

Transfer TF-8893 is complete. We moved $5,000 in promo credit from workspace ws_8f3a (BrightFleet-sandbox) to ws_1b2c (BrightFleet-prod). You should see the credit applied on the Billing -> Credits page for prod.

Attached: promo_transfer_confirmation.pdf (confirmation id TF-8893), and a short CSV export showing the negative promo line in sandbox and the credit in prod: billing_reconciliation_20260630.csv.

If anything looks off on your end, please reply and we'll roll back and investigate. Otherwise, congrats — you should be able to consume the promo on prod immediately.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Billing Engineer, Redwood Inference
